family_reports.body: The system has gaslighted my children just as their abuser has, dismissed abuse repeatedly to the point of betrayal, and minimized the years of single parenting under coercive control I have survived. The court has belittled my children and I in the most damaging ways.
Family Court is the battlefield of psychological warfare. They are causing lifetime traumas with no accountability or oversight!
